title: MMR recommendations revised: adults born in 1966 or later now eligible for assessment
summary: Taiwan CDC revised its MMR recommendations: adults born in 1966 or later without measles immunity should be assessed fo…
bodyMarkdown:
Taiwan CDC revised its MMR recommendations: adults born in 1966 or later without measles immunity should be assessed for a self-paid dose 2–4 weeks before travel; workers in frequent contact with foreign nationals were added.

Taiwan Centers for Disease Control (Taiwan CDC) press release. Full English text is a simulated export; Chinese source is the authoritative version.
